Swiss Army Bench 0.0.15: two extensions to install from the Extensions page, Accounting and Power Apps, and your library.

- **Extensions you can install:** the rail's Extensions page now offers **Accounting** and **Power Apps**. Install
  is one click: the app stops, installs this same version with the extension, and starts again with it on;
  Remove takes it out the same way. Updates keep your installed extensions. The agent asks for your Allow first.
- **Accounting** (an extension): an Accounting project's deliverable is an Excel workbook built by a Python
  automation. The Excel canvas places tables, pivots (summary tables computed by DuckDB), native charts, titles and
  text on each sheet; Play builds the workbook and shows it; Export writes `workbook.py`, which builds the same
  workbook without the app. Import an existing workbook as a template (layout, formats, merged cells, named
  ranges), click its cells to bind them to data, then build statements or invoices: a dry run lists every file
  first, then one workbook per party (numbered, dated), with a register of what was built.
- **Power Apps** (an extension): Power Apps code apps from the app. Sign in and pick an environment, start a new
  code app from Microsoft's template, add Dataverse tables and connectors as data sources, browse the
  environment's connectors in the APIs explorer, run the app live in a pane, and push it. An API from the APIs page
  becomes a custom connector, its files shown before anything is created. It uses Microsoft's `pa` command line
  for the app and `pac` for environments and connectors.
- **Your library:** connections, key vaults, saved blades, colours and variables now live in one folder on this
  computer (Settings, Library), as plain files made to be a Git repository you can share; never a secret in it.
  Your existing ones move there on the first start (a backup is kept). Key vaults are on the Variables page.
- **Projects know their type:** an Accounting or code app project sets what New offers, which blade families come
  first and which tools the agent sees first.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.15), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
